product_category.value: Immersive VR simulation platform dedicated to nursing education and nurse training, built by nurses for nurses

evidence.quote: UbiSim is dedicated exclusively to nursing education simulation and virtual reality.
The UbiSim immersive virtual reality simulation platform is built by nurses, for nurses to meet the evolving needs of nurse learners in higher education and healthcare institutions.

product_category.note: Nursing only. The first quote is the homepage META DESCRIPTION line. The about-us page says 'UbiSim is a Labster product.'

evidence.quote: UbiSim works on the entire wireless Quest family of headsets, including Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest Pro.
VR application with full visual and haptic immersion
Just create a Meta account, follow our step-by-step headset setup guide, and install the UbiSim app.

platforms.note: Learners use Meta Quest headsets. The facilitator uses 'A laptop or desktop computer with Windows/Mac operating system and Chrome browser. No software installation required.' (how-it-works); that is an educator tool, so Web is not listed. Observers can watch 'on their computers' or join as a 'ghost' in VR, and the pricing page lists 'web replay' as part of debriefing; neither describes the learner's simulation running in a browser.

evidence.quote: Every subscription comes with access to the growing UbiSim catalog of peer-reviewed scenarios, plus all custom scenarios shared from the UbiSim Community.
Included at no extra charge, UbiSim’s industry-leading scenario editor gives you maximum flexibility without increasing costs or coordination challenges.
No coding is needed. Drag and drop elements such as lab results, X-rays, EKGs, and even conversational dialogue into the scenario.
Share, edit and re-use custom scenarios with fellow educators in the UbiSim Community
Learners speak naturally with patients, family members, and physicians in the headset, and characters respond in real time with nurse-validated responses.
A complete dialogue transcript sits alongside performance data, so you can see what learners did and what they said.
Performance is organized by NCLEX Client Needs categories, which makes it easy to target teaching where it counts.
Instant, AI-enhanced performance reports
Up to 3 active learners can collaborate together in the same simulation
UbiSim supports flexible facilitation methods — from peer-to-peer role rotation and team-based multiplayer to educator-led and observation
Facilitator-led & independent, with AI-assisted options
Sessions are captured automatically, so you can review learners' decisions, timing, and actions, then lead data-informed debriefs that turn practice into competency.
End-to-end pre-brief, sim, and debrief
Campus and cohort management tools
UbiSim supports single sign-on via Microsoft Entra ID

key_capabilities.note: Other features stated but not listed: unfolding orders that appear as a scenario progresses (intuitive-editor); 'Multi-tiered debriefing with self-guided reflection, quizzes, and web replay', 'Scenario progression based on learner actions', 'Remote access for multi-site and multi-facility programs', 'Hardware distribution and management assistance' (pricing); scenario filters by system, learner level and type of care (scenarios). Catalog areas named: Fundamentals, Med-Surg 1 and 2, Pediatrics, Mental Health, Obstetrics, plus Tutorials. No scenario count is stated. The healthcare-systems page says 'unscripted dialogue' while the how-it-works page describes learners 'triggering the preset dialogs on the computer' in peer-to-peer mode.

target_customer.value: Nursing schools (colleges and universities) and hospitals and health systems, plus workforce development programs. Learners are pre-licensure nursing students, new graduate nurses in transition to practice, and practicing nurses.

evidence.quote: to meet the evolving needs of nurse learners in higher education and healthcare institutions.
Support new-graduate Transition to Practice and ongoing competency development
Provide a consistent foundation that helps learners progress and programs retain them
whether pre-licensure nursing students or practicing nurses.

target_customer.note: Menus list three segments: Academic Institutions, Healthcare Systems, Workforce Development. Implementation packages are split 'For Colleges and Universities' and 'For Hospitals and Health Systems' (onboarding-setup). Pricing FAQ: 'UbiSim is licensed at the institution or program level'.

value_proposition.value: Unlimited, realistic, repeatable VR clinical practice for nurses, with performance data showing readiness for the bedside, and simulation capacity that scales without scaling cost or faculty workload.

evidence.quote: Give every learner unlimited, realistic clinical practice in VR, and the performance data to prove they're ready for the bedside.
Expand simulation capacity beyond the limits of clinical placements and lab time without adding faculty workload.

value_proposition.note: Cost and outcome claims also appear: pricing says 'Up to 85% Lower Upfront Costs and 72% Increased Enrollment Capacity' 'Based on industry benchmark modeling'; home says students who practiced pre-briefing in UbiSim VR 'scored 57% higher in clinical judgment'.

evidence.quote: Where Nursing Practice Gets Real™.
Where Nursing Practice Gets Real™.

tagline.note: Marked as a trademark and repeated in the footer of every page read. Other candidate: homepage first headline after the menu 'Scale Clinical Practice. Build Practice-Ready Nurses.'

pricing.value: Custom pricing by quote, based on learner volume, term length and implementation tier; annual engagements typically begin at $5,000 USD. Implementation is a separate one-time package (Basic, Essentials, Custom). Licensed at institution or program level; free trials for qualified buyers; headsets procured separately.
